classification_note: The pure units are interpreted exposed seafloor bedrock. Composite Qms/ units have a thin, potentially ephemeral sediment cover and are not classified as exposed rock in this screen. Lithology interpretation used multibeam, backscatter, samples where available and other geology; it is not a sample at every cell.
